title: Sprite stack
description: One TypeBox action turns four pixel-art views into a sprite you can spin. The same action runs in process, over HTTP, from the typed client, and as an MCP tool.
features: One action, called in process, over HTTP, from the typed client, and as an MCP tool
TypeBox input and output on a single defineTool with http: true
A canvas turntable served by the same app
runNote: The server listens on port 4310. Open it for the turntable. POST /mcp exposes the stack tool.
